description:
Set the instructions that ship WITH a project — controls, what to press, what it does. R3 renders them in a modal behind a floating "?" button and the H key, in the editor and in the live portal alike, so whoever opens your preview link can read them. This is the built-in surface for that; do not build your own overlay in a Code component.

The body is markdown — headings, bullets, `code`, links. Write the controls the way a player would need them, e.g. "## Controls\n\n- `Space` — jump".

A project has ONE help. Call this again and it replaces the text rather than adding a second. REPLACING needs baseVersion, the codeVersion r3_component_read gave for the Help: text is never merged, so a write on an older version is refused with the current text. The first Help needs none. The optional title is the modal's heading ("Controls", "How to play"); leave it out to keep "Help".

Kept at once in the project's live copy: every R3 tab with the project open shows it now. The result gives you the component's entityRef — pass that to r3_component_set to change the trigger key, move or hide the button, or have the help open automatically on load.

baseVersion.description: REQUIRED when the project already has a Help: its codeVersion, from r3_component_read. Leave it out for the first Help.

markdown.description: The help text, as markdown. Replaces whatever is there.

projectId.description: The project to write into, from r3_project_create or r3_project_load.

title.description: Heading shown at the top of the modal, e.g. "Controls". Default "Help".

name: r3_help_write

answer.description: This answer in words: what was done, what R3 measured, decided or refused, and what to do next. The same text as the result's text block. Read it: the fields beside it are the data, this is the guidance.

title: Write the project's help overlay
